flows.title: Add a product
steps: From your Shopify admin, go to Products.
From the Products page, click Add product.
Enter a title for your product, along with any additional details that you want to add.

flows.title: Find an order
steps: From your Shopify admin, go to Orders.
Use the search box to find an order by its order number, customer name, email address, or product details.
Or narrow the list using filters like fulfillment status, payment status, sales channel, date range, or tags.

flows.title: Add a customer
steps: From your Shopify admin, go to Customers.
If the customer agreed to receive marketing emails and has an email address entered, check Customer agreed to receive marketing emails in the Customer overview section.
In the Tax settings section, select whether to collect tax for this customer.
